description: This file contains Alembic migration scripts for fixing schema permissions in the Superset project, including class definitions for database tables and functions to update schema permissions.

classes.name: SqlaTable
classes.description: Represents the 'tables' database table with schema and permission info.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Represents the 'slices' database table with schema permission info.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: Represents the 'dbs' database table with database name.

methods.name: fix_datasets_schema_perm
methods.description: Updates schema permissions for datasets based on database name and schema.

methods.name: fix_charts_schema_perm
methods.description: Updates schema permissions for charts based on related dataset and database.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs the migration upgrade, applying schema permission fixes unless using SQLite.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Placeholder for downgrade logic, currently does nothing.
